notes.title: Dealer’s Life Legend Launches Into Early Access!
notes.content:
It’s been a long time coming for us as a team, and now we're so excited to bring you the latest and greatest installment in the Dealer’s Life series - [b]Dealer’s Life Legend[/b]! 

Until the 22nd of January, you’ll be able to pick up Dealer’s Life Legend with a 10% launch discount so hop aboard, the title of Pecunia’s finest merchant is yours to claim 👑 You can [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]join our community in Discord[/url] to get tips, show off your biggest deals, and give us feedback for Early Access, we’d love to hear your thoughts on how we can make this the best Dealer’s Life yet! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185030/Dealers_Life_Legend/

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]The world is your oyster! [/b]- Your caravan is your shop and can be customised to your liking. Gather relics, goods and oddities from across the empire, ensuring your shop is THE place to go. 
[*] [b]Haggle your way to the top[/b] - Fine-tune your haggling skills and charisma to sway customers and make bags of money. Visit the auction house, interact with customers and stock the hottest commodities. During your growth as a merchant you’ll come across quests that will allow you to gain unique items or add boons to your skills. 
[*] [b]Dabble in the mystics[/b] - Magical, cursed and forgotten objects may fall into your hands along the way. Use them alongside magical potions to your advantage. 
[*] [b]Make friends and enemies[/b] - Use your charm to navigate the factions and choose who you will ally with. Beware! Based on how you interact with other competitors who share your quest, you’ll forge lasting connections or build strong rivalries.
[/list]
We’ve already localised the game into a whole host of languages including Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish, Thai, German, and more. If you have a desire for more languages, let us know in [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]our Discord[/url], we’d love to hear from you! If you do enjoy the game, please leave a review, it makes a big difference! 

[h2]Launch Trailer[/h2]

Your friendly indie devs,

notes.title: Dealer’s Life Legend: Early Access Releasing in January!
notes.content:
It is with great pleasure and honour for us to announce that Dealer’s Life Legend is going to launch in Early Access on [b]Steam 15th January 2025[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185030/Dealers_Life_Legend/

You heard it right, release time is just around the corner, so we encourage you to press that “Wishlist” button if you haven't already, this way you’ll be notified at the exact moment the game will be available! We also have a shiny new trailer for you to see what you can expect from Dealer’s Life Legend.

[previewyoutube=nTNFjAeSa00;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[h3]QUESTS & COMPANIONS[/h3]
Now let’s talk about a huge new feature: quests! Many folks in town need your help to overcome tons of missions. It’s too dangerous out there by yourself and you’re too important to risk your life, so this means that you’ll need to send Companions to embark on these perilous adventures! Whether your Companions will come back with their backpack full of treasures or beaten and wounded, is up to their Skills and your choices. Choose the best Companion to send on each quest, prepare yourself with a range of potions to turn the tides in your favour and cross your fingers for the outcome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835319/08ad5184c2e3bb450f2d32a0a80b1b6cbd72b3b8.png[/img]

[h3]GAMEPLAY TUTORIAL[/h3]
We heard your feedback loud and clear and we developed a detailed in-game tutorial with a proper explanation for every game mechanic, this way you can undertake the Wandering Merchant Quest armed with knowledge and wisdom! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835319/42373066680f637935b65b1a614589e7cf8273d6.png[/img]

[h3]LOCALISATION[/h3]
Speaking of languages, we currently have 8 languages already included at the start of Early Access. If yours is still not listed on the Steam page, don’t worry, we are already planning to add more as we work towards full launch. Just send us a message on [url=https://discord.gg/DXuuj6v]Dealer’s Life discord server[/url] to show your interest in that specific language.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835319/22b49d8c1c61519e0362fa9c66fdaf66f6ae7e78.png[/img]
[h3]ADDITIONAL FEATURES[/h3]
There are a heap of new gameplay aspects that you haven’t got to experience which we are excited to share! This includes travelling from city to city with special events, the majestic Capital biome, the game ending, overall game balancing, bug fixing and lots more.

We’re far from developing everything we have in mind, and we already have lots of new features and improvements planned, but we think this is a great starting point to deliver Dealer’s Life into Early Access! We love hearing your feedback and are excited to build Dealer’s Life Legend with you all, as usual join our [url=https://discord.gg/DXuuj6v]Dealer’s Life discord server[/url] to stay up to date!

In conclusion, thank you for all your support and for all the love you showed to our game demo. We can't wait to share this journey with you!

Stay tuned for more updates!

Your friendly indie devs,
Abyte Entertainment

notes.title: 🔥 Dealer's Life 2! 🔥
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to all Great Dealers out there!

We have great news today. This is the huge news we always hinted all our announcements at during these last months. The kind of news that was so hard to keep secret and that we'd like to shout to the world...

Now we can finally reveal to you... [b][u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343670/Dealers_Life_2]Dealer's Life 2[/url][/u][/b]! ːdlgiftː

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343670/Dealers_Life_2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/6d90a5dd0de5561fbb9ecb91527caa812a5e211f.gif[/img][/url]

You know how much we worked on Dealer's Life and how much we have improved it during these wonderful four years since its first Android build, but we always knew that our game could have been even better if we had built it on more solid foundations. In order to do this we had to rebuild the whole game with [b]wonderful new graphic assets and an even better refactored code[/b].
[b]Dealer’s Life 2 graphics are insanely beautiful[/b], so full of character and humor, so much rich in details and colors and the entire interface of the game has been greatly improved and polished. Thanks to the refactored code, [b]Dealer's Life 2 gameplay is enriched with new features and improvements[/b], even more can be developed with many already planned!

Here's a proof that shows how much the graphic quality has been improved!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343670/Dealers_Life_2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/3b92678a4df8e69eeb8d0186c64e2398ef74c69c.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Everything is so much better[/b] and we are so happy that we’ve finally come to the point that all of you Great Dealers will soon be able to enjoy what we’re creating for you!
Right now, [b]all core mechanics are working smoothly[/b], [b]we have already developed some new mechanics[/b] (e.g.: random events with choices! Pawner customers!) and we are working a lot in order to take this title to the peak we’re planning to reach!
For that, we will initially release the game in Early Access and we will continue working on it during the following months improving mechanics, adding new features and a ton of new content, with our beloved community help and feedback.

Here’s a quick list of our planned improvements:
[list][*]New items, for a total of at least 800 different items that will be used to generate an infinite amount of variations. You’ll be able to browse them in a new Item Catalogue feature
[*]New customer appearances with new poses, new faces, hairs and clothes that will make each new customer a unique blend of surprise and wonder
[*]Holiday themed content: dedicated special characters and possibly quests, dedicated shops graphics, dedicated items and customer appearances
[*]New visual effects and animations
[*]New encounters and special characters, new stories, difficult decisions to make and challenging tasks to complete
[*]Improvements on the negotiation engine to reproduce each possible behaviour or trait of a real customer
[*]Game difficulty levels, in order to let everyone play Dealer’s Life 2 with the preferred amount of challenge
[*]New types of auction
[*]New ways to make money (and get loans) through the bank
[*]New unlockable characters to play with unique powerful avatars
[*]The great Trophy Hall, a new main menu section in which you can check the best items you’ve found while playing
[*]A ton of achievements and leaderboards[/list]
... And we are sure we are forgetting something here.

[b]We can’t wait to show you everything we have in mind![/b] As always we'll track everything in our [url=https://trello.com/b/nAAmRDHM/dealer-s-life-roadmap]Public Roadmap[/url], just let us prepare everything in these following days after this big announcement! ːdlgiftː

We hope you are [b]as excited as we are[/b], let us know what you think in the comments! ːsteamhappyː

Your friendly indie devs,
Abyte Entertainment

notes.title: Dealer’s Life 1.23 Update: Landmarks and Souvenirs + Sale 20% off!
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to all Great Dealers out there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/124948de49a5b37a2abcaaafb10bd8182f7e8edf.gif[/img]

First of all, these are difficult times, we know that a lot of you are stuck at home right now trying to work or learn remotely and we really understand you because we actually are in the same situation since almost one month ago: we are from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milan]Milan[/url], which is in [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lombardy]Lombardy[/url], the most hit region in Italy.
[b]Try to keep your spirits up in these days[/b], call your friends and your family, especially the ones you know could need a kind word in a situation like this, try to stay physically and mentally healthy, play the games you like (solo or with your friends) and make the best of your time.
And [b][u]always[/u][/b] follow all the instructions from your local health officials.

That being said, today we both are remotely here and one meter apart ( ːlunar2019smilingpigː ) to announce the release of the [b]Landmarks & Souvenirs 1.23 Update[/b] with a lot of new content! And, to celebrate it, we just started [b]a new sale[/b] where you can buy Dealer's Life [b]at 20% off[/b]! ːdlgiftː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/c786f067c3dd76be140e59f833b303e45d15cbb7.png[/img]

Also, [b]the in-game Easter event starts today[/b]: your shop is sparkling with lights and decorations, look for some special items that are available only during the event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/320583359a7df791253ab1141ec7c3e6bdc4d5cb.png[/img]
 
Here are the release notes for this update:

[h1]V. 1.23[/h1]
[list][*][b]New Item Pack #13[/b] - Landmarks and Souvenirs! Look for more than 30 brand new items related to landmarks and art pieces from all around the world!
[*]You can now hire the [b]Advertiser[/b], a smart marketer who will attract more customers into your shop by performing advertising campaigns
[*]Raised the cap of active employees (Restorers, Experts, Brainwashers, Forgers) from 2 to 3
[/list]
So, let's start with items: in this update you'll find the new and marvelous [b]Item Pack #13[/b] with [b]30+ new items[/b] dedicated to [b]landmarks and art pieces from all over the world[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/412ddd7625bb7f106b8df9918283df86bb9a41a2.gif[/img]

We added many items from each country where the 7 languages currently included in Dealer's Life are spoken and some iconic landmarks from other parts of the world.
We decided to use actual names of landmarks and pieces of art because we think this is better for player immersion and sense of belonging for the countries we included, also in this way everyone will recognize almost all the references.
Remember to take a screenshot and share it with your friends if you like a particular item! All public screenshots can be found here => https://steamcommunity.com/app/982270/screenshots/ , where we often comment the best ones! ːdleggː

Speaking about long time requests, we added a new employee: [b]the Advertiser[/b]!
We prepared the assets for this new employee a long time ago following the idea of a passive employee who raises the average number of daily customers, during the development of this update we decided that we finally had to include him into the game and designed his role and his algorithms.
And here's an Advertiser looking to be hired:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/bcbaffefb0f350e5cd09f1d3f0a0fbdd2d63c01e.png[/img]
Those name and surname look familiar, aren't they? ːlunar2019crylaughingpigː ːdleggː

To discuss further about this topic, here's a list about all the things that influence the number of customers you'll see daily in your shop:
[list][*][b]Your shop[/b] is the first (and possibly the most important) thing: every shop has a maximum number of daily customers which of course influences the highest number that can be generated!
[*][b]Your inventory[/b] gives a boost depending on how many rare, epic, legendary and mythic items you have.
[*]The total value of your [b]Luck[/b] skill gives a boost, so having 9 skill points in Luck and a level 3 Lucky Guy for a total Luck value of 12 gives the best boost possible.
[*]Your [b]Advertiser[/b] gives a boost depending on his level of expertise.
[*]There are some [b]Ongoing Events[/b] that influence the number of customers you'll see, some are pretty strong (in increasing or decreasing them, depending on the event) and you will definitely feel them.[/list]
So, your shop changes the maximum number of customers while the other points change the average number of customers you'll see!
Remember that, as always with the procedural generation, "on average" does not mean "every time" which means that you can hire a Level 3 Advertiser and still see a day with a low number of customers, but on average you'll surely see his nice boost! ːdlsuitcaseː

Speaking about game mechanics, we also updated our guide to include the latest changes, it's the same guide as always but updated, you can read it here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1640583205

Moving on, the last change in this update is related to [b]how many active employees[/b] (Restorers, Experts, Brainwashers, Forgers) [b]you can hire[/b].
A bit of history on this topic: in the very early days of the game the cap was set to 1, using the same cap that by design is needed on passive employees (Clerks, Lucky Guys, Analysts, Profilers and now Advertisers). Those can't be hired multiple times otherwise your skills would get a very high bonus and possibly overflow all the maximum values. Back then we listened to feedback from our players and understood that [b]"more choices = more fun"[/b] and, knowing that active employees had no real constraints, we raised that cap to 2.
Following that very principle, we re-evaluated the impact on the game balance and we decided to [b]further raise this cap from 2 to 3[/b], meaning that it's now time to do that crazy playthrough you have in mind where you have [b]9 Brainwash charges[/b] every day! ːlunar2019laughingpigː

notes.content:
Good day to all Great Dealers out there! ːdldollarː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/124948de49a5b37a2abcaaafb10bd8182f7e8edf.gif[/img]

We hope you had wonderful holidays! After a small break for Christmas, we are again full of energy and ready to release awesome new content for Dealer’s Life! :D
Today we are proud to announce the release of the [b]Games & Legends 1.22 Update[/b], with a lot of new content and nice changes! ːdlgiftː

Here are the release notes:

[h1]V. 1.22[/h1]
- New Item Pack #12 - Games and Legends! Look for 25 brand new items related to iconic video games and cartoons!
- Improved background quality
- Dynamic "max year" for modern items, VIPs and historical contexts
- Enabled share button for taking screenshots
- Performance improvements
- Bug fixes ("Hire" label on the "Hire Employee" article)

First of all we gave some love to PC platform by [b]greatly improving the visual quality of shops[/b], so now they look much better on a PC screen. On Steam we also enabled a [b]dedicated in-game button to take screenshots[/b] of items, just like the mobile version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/2f5a7c876dfa1966a1272e66ba754d0bbd191033.png[/img]

Talking about items, we [b]improved the year calculation of modern items and features[/b] by automatically considering the current year as the maximum year of production available! With this change, the game will automatically consider the current year (e.g.: 2020) in ranges for all modern items, VIPs and historical contexts, instead of a fixed year (e.g.: 2019).

But the biggest improvement we’re releasing with Dealer's Life 1.22 update is our third and final step into the geek world: the new and shiny [b]Item Pack #12[/b] with [b]25 new items[/b] dedicated to [b]video games and iconic characters[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/5fe0e07cb3d69461907794a2ac810a9e63e9b208.png[/img]

This item pack, along with “Heroes & Bad Guys” and “Movies & Games” packs previously released, would like to be [b]our personal and most devoted tribute[/b] to all great titles and characters we loved in the years, from the far 80’s till recent days. We have to say we are particularly fond of these items since many of them were an important part of our childhood as gamers and anime fans, along with many others we didn’t manage to include but we love in the same way. It’s thanks to them that we are now here, developing Dealer’s Life and hopefully many other titles in the future. That’s why this specific update is very important for us: it defines [b]a very big milestone for Dealer’s Life[/b], a big accomplishment for us with a personal touch to celebrate in our way the whole world of entertainment that has a special place in our hearts.

As of now, developing Dealer’s Life took us [b]more than three full-time years[/b] and it now includes [b]over 540 different items[/b] combined with [b]nearly 200 special features[/b] (from connections with famous personalities to historical or fictional events), more than [b]100 different special characters encounters and random events[/b], and literally [b]countless references[/b] to movies, video games, real life events and much much more!   
We spent really a lot of time and energy on our creation, polishing, improving and creating new content for it. Everything was released in [b]more than one hundred free updates[/b] since our very first Alpha release on Android devices in September 2016.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34283830/9248d10d49d5f699a26d7f3baf573d089306e55d.png[/img]
[i]Comparison between DL early alpha and DL 1.14 update (January 2019, just before the Steam release!)[/i]

Now that we feel that our game is solid and polished, we want to increase its price a bit to include all these years of work and all these free updates. ːdlgiftː
This is something that will help us but will not affect at all any player that has already bought the game, which we think is very important as [b]we always want to be as fair as possible[/b], especially with all the players that have already supported us! 

What will come next, you say? Well, it’s been quite a while that we’re talking about something big coming out soon. Actually, all I can say about it is that big news require big effort to be announced. Be patient, Great Dealers, as [b]something very big is coming[/b]…

And with this cryptic statement we conclude today’s update! Stay tuned and keep up the good deals in this wonderful beginning of a new year! :D

notes.title: Dealer’s Life 1.18 update: Storage Auctions!
notes.content:
A big hello to every Great Dealer out there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/124948de49a5b37a2abcaaafb10bd8182f7e8edf.gif[/img]
We are proud to announce a new wonderful update for Dealer’s Life, reaching [b]version 1.18[/b] with a lot of new features for you to enjoy!

Here are the release notes:

[h1]V. 1.18[/h1]
[list][*]Storage auctions are here! Test your skills by facing this new challenge!
[*]All auctions are now more frantic and challenging
[*]New and improved sound effects
[*]Steam Leaderboards and Achievements!
[*]Text improvements and fixes
[*]Bug fixes[/list]

Let’s start right away and talk about the biggest feature we’re introducing with this update: [b]storage auctions[/b]!
These were planned since the beginning and were strongly requested by our Community, they are a whole new way of doing auctions in the game: they’re [b]more risky, more expensive and much harder than standard auctions[/b]!
When joining a storage auction you can look at a storage room where some items will be highlighted. You get a brief description of every item but you don’t know their estimated value, although you have some visual hints about their rarity and their condition.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/fdc6cb9f22111bfc3f02f8ff71cfb2cdf20e79ee.png[/img]

You have to buy the whole lot in a single purchase, winning a single auction. We’re talking about 3 or 4 quite valuable items in every storage auction so prepare yourself because the needed budget here will be much bigger. In addition even after you buy the items you won’t know their estimated value unless, as usual, you give them to an Expert to be analyzed.
You could discover that some items you bought are worth less than what you paid but you could also discover that among those overpaid items there is that one single item that is really valuable and you ended up paying it really less than its value! Also, these items could be in bad condition so, as usual, you can repair them or even transform them into counterfeits to increase their value!
[b]It’s all up to you, your skill and resources[/b], it will cost you some money and days of work for your employees but in the end it could also bring you really big gains!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/f9b8c86a3aff69f56e6c6278e6726ab07ec0b801.png[/img]

You could end up paying a real lot without actually knowing if it was worth it or not, so be sure to [b]sharpen your skill[/b] before deciding to invest a huge amount of cash in a storage auction! For this reason, storage auctions are available once every week but only starting from the Apprentice Fame Level.

We wanted to include something harder and riskier to give a good challenge especially during mid and late game and we know that you’ll really like this new cool kind of auctions.

We also [b]improved all auctions[/b] (even the standard ones) by reducing their countdown and rebalancing a few parameters. So now [b]all auctions are more frantic and challenging[/b], you can’t get distracted even for a moment since it’s easier to lose by merely not paying enough attention. 

Since we increased the number of different auction types, we wanted to add some visual distinction between them so we introduced [b]dedicated graphics on their newspaper articles[/b].
You’ll have a gavel with some money for auctions where you can sell items:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/85803c7550efa095bd13b948e1a148b737755bbc.png[/img]

A gavel with boxes for auctions in which you can buy items:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/6003addc68aee1961339747027a6a503bc3db442.png[/img]

And finally a gavel with a storage room for storage auctions!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/45c799cbfbd0307d9ea5a2c7ea7700d194c70599.png[/img]

There are so many improvements on auctions that we decided to put some more love in the sound compartment too: we [b]changed some sound effects during auctions[/b] and we already included a brand new dedicated sound effect for storage auctions!
In addition to this, we added a new sound when locking an item in your inventory.
These improvements on sound effects are just the beginning, we’re planning to put [b]more and better sound effects[/b] quite everywhere in the game in the following updates! 

Moving on, let’s talk about [b]Steam Leaderboards[/b]. That’s right, they’re now up and running so you can compete with your friends and see who makes the best deal ever! We introduced [b]six leaderboards[/b] in total:
[list][*]Top grossing Dealers within the first 4 weeks
[*]Top grossing Dealers within the first 16 weeks
[*]Top grossing Dealers of all time
[*]Top grossing item
[*]Top quickest Dealers to win by in-game days
[*]Top quickest Dealers to win by time played[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/f37c84c4a3381b9a2d1506053eb71daeea354eb3.png[/img]

As you can see everyone can find something to their taste: whether you like to stick to the early game, find the best item ever or go for the fastest win ever, you have your leaderboard to dominate! You will finally show to everybody that you’re the best Great Dealer ever seen on Earth!
[b]Are you ready for the big climb[/b]? :D

Last but not least, we never stop improving our localizations so with this version you’ll see some text fixes. We also added [b]more variety for customer speeches[/b], especially when negotiating and when a deal ends.

That’s all for this update, we really hope you’ll like all the improvements and all the work we put in it! As usual, we look forward for your feedback so feel free to comment here or on [url=https://trello.com/b/nAAmRDHM/dealers-life-public-roadmap]our Public Roadmap[/url]!
More updates will soon come (anyone said more items? :D ) so stay tuned and keep up the good deals!

Your friendly indie devs,
Abyte Entertainment

notes.content:
Hello and welcome to all Great Dealers out there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/124948de49a5b37a2abcaaafb10bd8182f7e8edf.gif[/img]

Today we’re back with another update and this one includes some changes that were requested by a huge number of our players! So we developed them in a timely manner and managed to release them in [b]less than a month since the latest update[/b]!

Here are the release notes!

[h1]V. 1.17[/h1]
[list][*] Turkish localization!
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Minor text and bug fixes[/list]

Let’s start with the [b]Turkish Localization[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/52b112912cb09ff3f31c1d0e161a5982e2fb462e.png[/img]

Dealer’s Life is having a [b]huge success[/b] in Turkey and we understand that playing a game in your own language can improve a lot your experience, especially when there is a lot of text like in DL.
This was a [b]very popular request[/b] and we really received a lot of messages and reviews about it: most of these were polite and kind, but honestly others were not so polite and not so kind.
We decided to listen to the kindest ones and, with the work of a professional and passionate translator, [b]we managed to complete the Turkish Localization in just a couple of weeks[/b]! 
As usual our [url=https://trello.com/c/n91Kmm8Q/105-text-mistakes-or-suggestions]Roadmap[/url] is always open if you find any typo, which can happen in a game with so many lines of text!

We hope this will make all the Turkish speaking players happy! Please consider reviewing or sharing the game if you want to show us your support!

The next big change in this update concerns [b]Steam Achievements[/b]!
We didn’t include them at launch on Steam because we prioritized other tasks but we announced that we would have developed them as soon as possible, especially since the structure to support them was already implemented in the game and working fine on the mobile services (Google Play Games and Apple Game Center). notes.title: A word about Dealer’s Life privacy policy
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to all Great Dealers out there!

Today we’d like to spend a word on [b]Dealer’s Life privacy policy[/b].
We know that reading privacy policies is boring (believe us, it’s the same for us when having to write them!) and we also know that sometimes they can seem "scary" as they are not written in an "ordinary" language (some companies even exploit this thing). The two things combined may trigger fears for your personal information.

If you want to know more, the first advice regarding our privacy policy is to read it carefully and till the end, you should not stop at the first line and then start fearing for the worst because [b]there is absolutely nothing out of the ordinary in our policy[/b].

To prove this point [b]we just [url=https://abyteentertainment.com/privacy-policy/]updated it[/url] and made it clearer[/b], especially for PC users as we have less active services on the PC versions of our games.

And to be even clearer, we will summarize here all the services we use in our games, including the "mobile users only" ones too to highlight that they are not included in the Steam PC version that you are playing!

[h1]Firebase Remote Config[/h1]
This is our remote configuration provider, [b]it lets us dynamically set in-game parameters[/b] without having to modify it (i.e.: we don’t have to release an updated build).
We use it to trigger “[b]Holiday Themes[/b]” (soon the Easter Theme will be activated!), to show in the main menu the “new version available” animation and to show on mobiles a special animation in Dealer’s Life Lite if the Premium version is on sale. We also have more ideas on this topic for the future, as this really helps setting events and special situations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/1f71425a45ea92a3aaa28cbc93222d08c0a1a5c7.gif[/img]
[i]🎵 Last Christmas, I gave you my Pixelated Pickaxe 🎵
🎵 but the very next day you gave it away 🎵[/i]

Firebase Remote Config uses various types of Data as specified in [url=https://policies.google.com/privacy]Google privacy policy[/url].

[h1]AdMob by Google (Mobile users only)[/h1]
This is our ads provider, we need it to [b]show ads on our mobile games[/b] and let you try Dealer’s Life Lite for free.

Google Admob uses cookies and unique device identifiers for advertising (Google Advertiser ID or IDFA, for example).
As per GDPR this is considered a “personal information” and this usage must be disclosed. We also added details on how to prevent its usage on both Google Play and App Store store descriptions.

The PC version does not have ads so of course this topic does not apply to PC players.

[h1]Google Analytics for Firebase (Mobile users only)[/h1]
This is our analytics provider and, for those of you who don’t know how analytics work, [b]they help track specific actions in the game for statistical purposes[/b]. In the early phase of Dealer’s Life development these were really important in helping us discover bugs or bad behaviors (especially connected to procedural generation) in the game.
Here are two examples that show how we use them:
[list]
[*]an event when a player has no special encounters available which help discover possible situations where the procedural generation for special encounters has “blocking” conditions that prevent the generation.
[*]an event that counts each game lost and each game won, which helped us keep the game balanced. In fact, if we saw too many games lost after an update, we were sure that we had changed something that made the game more difficult and this triggered a global balance check on our side.[/list]
Each event is of course completely anonymous meaning that we don’t know who has triggered the event but we just know what happened (i.e.: someone won the game).

Google Analytics for Firebase uses cookies, unique device identifiers for advertising (Google Advertiser ID or IDFA, for example) and Usage Data, 
as specified in [url=https://policies.google.com/privacy]Google privacy policy[/url].

This topic does not apply to PC players: the PC version does not have analytics as Google Firebase does not support PC builds, which is unfortunate because, as we said above, they really can be helpful in balancing the game, but we decided to work on other game-related tasks rather than find a new analytics provider.

[h1]Other services[/h1]
Google Play Games, Apple Game Center and Steam have their own privacy policies, if you want to know more be sure to read them on their websites.

[h1]In conclusion[/h1]
We don’t receive any real personal information about our players, we just use these tools to develop the game and provide the best level of quality possible for all our players.

As always, [b]if you have any question or concern feel free to ask[/b] and we’ll gladly answer as soon as possible.

Your friendly indie devs,
Abyte Entertainment

notes.content:
Good day to you, Great Dealers out there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/124948de49a5b37a2abcaaafb10bd8182f7e8edf.gif[/img]

We just released [b]version 1.16[/b] of Dealer’s Life and there is really a lot to talk about but before we begin with the usual listing of all the improvements of this update we would like to give a huge thank you to every Content Creator and every Streamer that are playing and enjoying our game.

It is so awesome to see how much love is coming from Youtube and Twitch, an incredible amount of playthrough videos keeps coming since our release on Steam and this is simply amazing!
We would love to name and thank every single one of you guys making videos but we don’t want to forget anyone, so we will just encourage every Great Dealer reading this article to search for [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=dealer%27s+life]Dealer's Life on Youtube[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Dealer%27s%20Life/videos/all]Dealer's Life on Twitch[/url][/b] and watch lots of playthrough videos!

We watched them all and, even if in many cases we couldn’t understand the language, they were all so awesome and funny to watch! Go check them out and you’ll find great videos in English, German, Czech, Turkish, Danish, Portuguese, Polish and many other languages! Let’s mobilitate and show as much love as we can to these guys, they really deserve it: watch their videos, follow their channels and give them a lot of likes! ❤

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/25b0c07db029192804e8740c30a3cea64eccd083.png[/img]

Let’s now get back to our new release.

[h1]V. 1.16[/h1]
[list][*]Portuguese localization!
[*]Custom mouse pointer
[*]Better visualization for weekly expenses in the "My shop" notebook section
[*]Improved game flow when locking/unlocking items and when assigning tasks to employees
[*]"Do not show this tip again" set by default on Tutorial Tips
[*]Weekly save game backup (still please don’t force quit abruptly the game while playing!)
[*]Minor text fixes (especially in German)
[*]Bug fixes[/list]

For the joy of our Portuguese speaking players we finally completed the [b]Portuguese localization[/b] for the game!
We hope this improvement can bring more enjoyment to all Portuguese players that are not familiar with foreign languages! Of course if you should find any issue with the new localization do not hesitate to let us know and we will fix it as soon as possible!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/69a22fb42a907bec8126f1c203da2a86a23baf9e.png[/img]

Moving on, while we were watching all those wonderful Dealer’s Life playthrough videos we thought that something had to be made to better highlight the mouse pointer, just to make the watcher more aware of the action performed by the streamer, so we introduced a nice [b]customized mouse pointer[/b] in the PC version of the game. The new pointer is now bigger and much more visible than the standard pointer, we hope this helps you having a clearer idea of where the mouse is pointing at any given time. Let us know if you like it!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/907e67720b7a3d37dea695db496b1f7580e759d3.png[/img]

Speaking about the next change, we would like to thank our great [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/982270/discussions/]Steam Community[/url] for giving us a lot of smart feedback about [b]quality of life improvements[/b] for the game!

Following our players feedback we decided to analyze the game flow and tried to understand if some passages could be improved in order to make the gaming experience more straightforward.
First of all we [b]improved weekly expenses visualization[/b] by moving them in the "My shop" notebook section: here we show the amount that will be paid at the end of the week as well as details on how much your shop and your employees cost.
Then we removed a popup window that was shown after assigning a task on an item since it didn’t provide any essential data.
In addition, the popup window that appears after locking an item has been converted into a tutorial tip that will be shown the first time an item is locked.
And finally, talking about tutorial tips, we decided to change the default value of the checkbox that dismisses them so that now all tutorial tips will show up only once unless you decide to unckeck the checkbox.

We also listened to the few of you that had some issues with the saved game. Even if you are very few we still think that losing progress of a long game should be avoided at all costs so we did our best by introducing a [b]backup save[/b].

Since the game automatically saves its progress quite often during the gameplay, if for any reason your game is shut down while saving, the result can be a corrupted saved game that can’t be loaded any more. Unfortunately we really can’t do anything about it (as all the icons with the “Do not shutdown while saving” warning explain in most games), but in this new release we will provide you a special backup that will be updated weekly. Should your saved game become corrupted, the game will automatically load the backup save and you’ll be able to continue from there. Of course you could lose a couple of days of gameplay but we know it is better to lose a few days than an entire game! :D

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/644d3287d20eeee32d8b9f09c3503a08356975f5.png[/img]

We also gave some more love to existing localizations and, thanks to the help of some of our most passionate Great Dealers, we managed to [b]fix many typos[/b], especially in German!

Lastly, remember that we also introduced a whole set of [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b]! We already talked about them but if you missed that announcement you can find all the details here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/982270/announcements/detail/1791775741707886090
That’s all for this update!
We hope you’ll like all these improvements! As usual more is coming with the following releases (yes, [b]Steam Achievements[/b]! And we are working on some big surprises too!), so stay tuned, don't forget to check our [url=https://trello.com/b/nAAmRDHM/dealers-life-public-roadmap]Roadmap[/url] and keep up the good deals!

Your friendly indie devs,

notes.content:
Hello and welcome to all Great Dealers out there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/124948de49a5b37a2abcaaafb10bd8182f7e8edf.gif[/img]

Today we’re back with another great update, the first one after the PC release that you guys made unforgettable thanks to all your fantastic reviews and playthroughs that every day pop up from around the world!

Back to the update, today we released [b]version 1.15[/b] of Dealer’s Life!

[h1]V. 1.15[/h1]
[list][*]New Item Pack #9 - Ready to furnish your house? Look for more than 25 brand new items, from TV sets to collectible toasters!
[*]New animation when examining the rarest items!

In this update you will find a brand [b]new item pack[/b] related to [b]houseware and furniture[/b]! This time we focused more on houseware and introduced [b]25+ new items[/b] spacing from fridges and dishwashers to lamps and stereo systems!
We really hope you’ll like them all but of course you’ve got to find them so... Let the hunt begin! ːlunar2019grinningpigː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/73215089e950660823846743252a8deeb9730caf.png[/img]

Of course we’re not finished with items yet!

We will love to evaluate your suggestions!

Moving on, with this release we also introduced some [b]visual changes on the item’s details screen[/b], adding a little and lovely animation for particularly rare items.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/cbaff41134599023ac2408919e6ebd079a851d93.gif[/img]

notes.title: Two weeks after the Steam release...
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Two weeks have passed since our [b]Steam release[/b] and we got so overwhelmed from all the things to do that we weren’t able to prepare a proper post-release announcement!

So… Let’s do it right away!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/124948de49a5b37a2abcaaafb10bd8182f7e8edf.gif[/img]

We [b]worked very hard on our game[/b] for more than two years and its release on Steam was a big milestone. As always, such a big moment can bring fears and doubts which ultimately can cover all the positive things of such an accomplishment.
But every negative thought vanished as soon as we hit the big green release button and saw [b]how much you all liked our game[/b]!
We are very happy for such a positive feedback and [b]we would like to thank you from the bottom of our hearts[/b] for all your nice messages, for all the good reviews, for all the feedback and for all the screenshots and videos that you posted!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/5308c4dac9c9735efdfb4fc10dad3dc88b38dc60.png[/img]

Speaking about [b]screenshots[/b], you accepted the challenge and uploaded lots of them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/982270/screenshots/]Steam Community Hub[/url]! Be sure to like and comment your favorite ones to let us know who should win the race for the best screenshot!
And, speaking about [b]videos[/b], we are very thankful to all the creators that took the time to record a video, or even a series: we had a great time watching them play our game, even if we couldn’t understand a single word for any language different from English and Italian, it was great to see them surprised, find references, make jokes, mimic our characters and [b]ultimately have fun[/b]! <3
If you haven't done it yet, check them out on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/982270/videos/]Steam Community Hub[/url] and on [url=https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=dealer%27s+life]YouTube[/url], you'll find dozens of videos in many languages, with German and English being the most common!

Enough with the release, now let's talk about our [b]next update[/b]!

First of all, we completed the new [b]Item Pack #9[/b] which adds more than 25 new Houseware items to look for and buy!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/73215089e950660823846743252a8deeb9730caf.png[/img]

With these items we have now completed all the item packs we had planned, so now it's your time to let us hear your voice and let us know what you’d like to see in the game! Post your ideas here or on the [url=https://trello.com/c/NXxLch0k/171-item-requests]“Item Requests” card on the Roadmap[/url], we'll keep track of the most desired items when we'll plan our next item pack!

Speaking of planning, you'll soon see a lot of movement on the Roadmap! We are checking all the tasks, both ours and community requested ones, in order to reevaluate them and [b]plan the next releases for the following months[/b]!

As per today, in the new [b]1.15[/b] update we will surely include:
[list][*]The new Item Pack #9
[*]Minor text fixes (thank you for reporting them!)[/list]
We are also already working on:
[list][*]A new graphical improvement on the screen where you examine a customer’s item
[*]Steam integrations: mentioned in our last announcement, with this you’ll be able to unlock our 45 achievements on Steam!
[*]Portuguese localization: approximately at 15%, hopefully completed for the end of the month.
[*]Some dedicated PC improvements (such as keyboard controls)[/list]
And then after completing the full reevaluation we’ll surely start working on something else!

Some of these tasks (e.g.: Steam integration or Portuguese localization) will need a special testing phase, so we will also check how to properly provide [b]Beta releases on Steam[/b]. Which means that, if you like, you’ll soon be able to opt-in the Beta program and then be able to test our latest releases before everyone else! Of course we’ll also make a dedicated announcement on this and keep you updated on what you’ll be able to test in Beta!

Last, but not least, many of you noticed that [b]Dealer’s Life price[/b] on Steam is particularly low, some of you were even scared a bit as usually a low price means a low-quality product.
Well, we obviously appreciate praises about the low price, but here’s the truth: this is the first game we develop and we had a lot of difficulties deciding a price tag. We know that DL is a high-quality product and we know we could have asked for more (on mobile we have been updating it every month for two years now) but being in doubt we decided to be "better safe than sorry".
Again, this may just be us two thinking in a different way than the "market standard", same as we did with IAPs that everyone probably would have included in a game like ours (energy bars, time to wait for customers and deals, and so on...).
Also, we managed to have a chat with a couple of experienced devs during these very frantic post-release days and decided to consider the possibility of raising the price after some updates, which in case will be announced in advance with no surprises.

In conclusion, [b]we’d like to keep updating the game for free[/b], with no IAPs and even no DLCs, evaluating a price increase in some updates. If this keeps going well we will show that there is an alternative which makes everyone happy: you, our players, will keep playing an updated game, we will be supported and we will have the financial stability to be able to update this game and then start developing a new one!
So… keep supporting our game and our decisions, spread the word on social platforms, share the game to your friends and [b]tell us what you think[/b]!

That’s all for now, thanks to all the Great Dealers out there and keep up the good deals!

Your friendly indiedevs,
Abyte Entertainment

notes.title: Dealer’s Life release approaching!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to our [b][u]first Steam announcement[/u][/b]!

[h1]First of all, let us introduce ourselves![/h1]
We are Abyte Entertainment, a two-man indie team founded by Tanek and Fiz, two italian developers with more than 10 years of experience in business projects, from web to e-commerce platforms, and 30 years as gamers. In 2016 we decided to capitalize our experience and follow a new path, designing and creating our first video game: [b]Dealer’s Life[/b].
Our focus is to create great quality video games by developing deep and detailed mechanics and we think we managed to achieve it in Dealer’s Life through an extremely advanced negotiation engine, procedural generation of items and customers, special characters with multiple choices dialogues and random events!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/e0b0724eb15f3153e54b3bedbead1eebe93b7e3c.png[/img]

[h1]Dealer's Life history[/h1]
Some of you might already know us because Dealer’s Life is available on mobile devices on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.AbyteEntertainment.DealersLifeFull&referrer=utm_source%3Dsteam%26utm_medium%3Da1]Google Play[/url] and [url=https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1438244426]App Store[/url].
Those of you who followed us since our mobile release and all our updates know that one of our commitments is to avoid implementing “widely (ab)used” business models (AKA “In-App Purchases”, or IAPs).
We [b]challenged the fact that all these mechanics are included by default in all simulation games[/b], we thought about energy bars to refill, time to wait and loot boxes and we said [b]“thanks, but no thanks”[/b]. So we decided to develop a Premium game that could be fully enjoyed by our players at their pace, when and how they want.
This stance towards our players also means that we decided to keep on [b]releasing new content for free each month[/b] during all these two years since our very first Early Access release on Android, adding new items, new mechanics and listening to feedback from our players!

[h1]And now?[/h1]
So, enough with us and with our game’s history, I know you are wondering: [b]what about now and the Steam release[/b]?
Well, on January 31st we are releasing DL on Steam after all these months of development as a “full game” but, as always, [b]we won’t stop working on it[/b]!

[h1]Our next tasks[/h1]
We are already working on:
[list][*][url=https://trello.com/c/okOBY8wG]Steam integrations[/url], meaning that soon you’ll be able to unlock our 45 achievements here on Steam!
[*]A new set of 25+ items to be included in item procedural generation (codename: “[url=https://trello.com/c/IyC8B7w2]Houseware & Furniture Pack #3[/url]”)
[*][url=https://trello.com/c/vdQYVzl0]Portuguese localization[/url] 
[*]Some dedicated [url=https://trello.com/c/TS6vbt2T]PC improvements[/url] (such as keyboard controls)
[/list]
You may have noticed the links in each of these tasks... that’s right, we have a [url=https://trello.com/b/nAAmRDHM/dealers-life-public-roadmap]Public Roadmap[/url] where you can track our progress (and see previews!), check all the planned tasks and releases and discuss them with us!

Are you ready to open your shop and become the best pawn broker out there?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34385377/124948de49a5b37a2abcaaafb10bd8182f7e8edf.gif[/img]

Feel free to [b]let us know what you think[/b] here in the comments or on our Public Roadmap!

Thank you and keep up the good deals!

Your friendly indiedevs,
Abyte Entertainment
